title: Reordered Power of 2
description: Check if any permutation of the digits of N forms a power of 2.
pseudocode:
1. count = countDigits(N)
2. for i = 0 to 30:
3.   power = 2^i
4.   if count == countDigits(power):
5.     return true
6. return false

steps.note: Compare digits of 10 ({1:1, 0:1}) with digits of 1 ({1:1})
Compare digits of 10 ({1:1, 0:1}) with digits of 16 ({1:1, 6:1})
